resolved.change: Flattened 34 control-flow findings in 16 F# files, preserving gate baselines and acceptance policy.
Resume retains the admitted work, logical run and authority root and installs its live completion waiter; restart does not replay the prompt.
Host binding obtains the durable authority root independently of the current physical input.
A successful settled child program commits the exact delivery witness with its physical execution, actual tool step, pre-call prose and sealed view.
Successful durable delivery publishes its completion through the existing Host terminal port; parent join consumes the original work even when natural stop belongs to another assistant step.
Sealing freezes material identities without advancing them; actual consumption advances only the captured identities.
Full checkout history restores the retained-archive verification anchor without disabling the gate.
Retired identities/facts and prose-only completion fixtures now follow the current model; valid payload proofs and all TODOs are retained.
Admitted owner work and unconsumed consequences remain visible after restart; idle DevOps bindings do not block Join.
rg honours .gitignore in ordinary directories; the JS test bridge supplies an actual int64 deadline.
Legacy human roots reject contradictory SelectedAgent/CanonicalRole evidence; valid DevOps remains DevOps.
The time-node public capability retains Node until an owned close wait settles; the original 3-second limit and unknown-resource blocker remain.
Use the Bun worker CLI environment only for the supervisory worker; a real compiled OpenCode regression proves output, exit status and target environment.
A later provider stop on the same delivered child exchange cannot revive its completed work or issue a new nudge.
Read and reopen lifecycle state at the primary state root. Subscribe before reading confirmed same-work commits and cancel/dispose the losing journal wait.
Use awaited view delivery, retained read-only SQLite observation, precise anchors, and an exact second-attempt fallback declaration; remove the obsolete step-0 Manager exception.
